info.title: API.SH: Xbox
info.description: The Xbox API from API.SH: public Xbox data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Games on sale on the Xbox store, biggest discount first: price, original price, discount, sale end date, rating, platforms, genres, maturity rating, Game Pass inclusion, image and link; filter by platform, genre, price band, multiplayer mode and rating, and sort another way. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/xbox-deals

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default discount).

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: series_xs, one, pc, handheld, cloud, play_anywhere (comma separated).

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Genres as the store names them (Shooter, Action & adventure, Role playing...), comma separated.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: free, under_5, 5_10, 10_20, 20_40, 40_60, over_60 (comma separated).

parameters.name: players
parameters.description: single, online, local, coop_online, coop_local, cross_platform, cross_platform_coop.

parameters.name: maturity
parameters.description: ESRB ratings EC, E, E10, T, M, AO (comma separated).

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Store country (two letters).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Paging cursor from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A game (or several) in any market: title, developer, publisher, description, release date, categories, platforms, capabilities (multiplayer, 4K, cross-save ...), Xbox Series and Play Anywhere flags, age ratings, user ratings (all time, 30 and 7 days), price, list price, sale end, editions, images and trailers. Each game also has `system_requirements` (PC minimum and recommended processor, graphics and hardware codes) where the store lists them. Opt-in `include` (one id only): `reviews` adds `rating_breakdown` (average, total and 5..1 star counts) and the top 10 user reviews (rating, title, text, date, gamertag, device, helpful votes, publisher response); `gamepass` adds `game_pass` (whether the console, PC, EA Play and cloud Game Pass catalogues carry the game in this market).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/xbox-game

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Store product id (12 characters, in the xbox.com link), or up to 20 separated by commas.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of id: an xbox.com store link.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Store country, two letters (default US).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the texts, e.g. en-US, de-DE, ja-JP (default en-<market>).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma separated extras for one game: reviews, gamepass.

parameters.name: review_sort
parameters.description: With include=reviews: helpful (default) or newest.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Games (or apps) matching the words, with full details per result (details=false for ids and titles only). Optional `sort` (price, price_desc, rating, release_date, title) and filters `genre`, `platform`, `players` and `price_max` apply to the matched games (they need details=true); `count` is the number left after filtering.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/xbox-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What (default games).

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Full details per result (default true).

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Store country, two letters (default US).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the texts, e.g. en-US, de-DE, ja-JP (default en-<market>).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the matched games.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only games whose category contains this word (e.g. shooter, racing, role playing).

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Only games available on this platform.

parameters.name: players
parameters.description: Only games with this play mode.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum current price in the market's currency.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
